title: $400 Small–Medium Business Power Outage Support Grant Far West Region Oct 2024 – Terms and Conditions
summary: This document outlines the terms and conditions for the $400 Small–Medium Business Power Outage Support Grant in the Far West Region.
who_can_apply: Must be a small or medium business.
Must be located in the Far West Region.
Must be affected by a power outage.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of this grant?
faqs.a: This grant provides $400 support to small and medium businesses in the Far West Region following a power outage.

faqs.q: What is the relationship between these Terms and Conditions and the Guidelines?
faqs.a: The Terms and Conditions are subject to the Guidelines, and the Guidelines take precedence if there is a conflict.
Service NSW reserves the right to change the grant amount or the terms of the grant.
